day_read: A thin, low-volume grind higher. NIFTY and BANKNIFTY sit near the top of the day's range (0.89 to 0.91 of range) on about a quarter to a third of normal volume, while price keeps whipsawing around VWAP and has hurt both VWAP models. Breadth is split, with a sharp IT-versus-Metal/Energy rotation, and VIX is up 5.5%: this is not a clean trend day, and churn is the enemy.

orb.why: Keep. The range is set, and the indices are pressing their highs, so a late clean break of the 30-minute range is the one breakout worth allowing.

vwap_revert.why: 0 wins in 9 trades across the fixed and @ai copies today; stretches from VWAP keep extending. Inverting would flip its small stop and far target into an unfavourable payoff, so it is switched off inst

bollinger_fade.why: It is the only fixed fader that is positive today (2 of 2, Rs +141) in a thin tape that is churning near the highs. A wide 2.5 sd band allows only rare, extreme stretches and avoids the overtrading th

rsi2.why: Keep the strict extremes. The 20-EMA filter will lean long while the indices sit at their highs, and the low thresholds limit churn in a thin tape.

volume_burst.why: Lost on both past days and today in every copy (fixed -154 on 12 trades, inv -79, @ai -63). Low tape volume makes bursts rare and unreliable, so neither side has an edge after charges.

vwap_trend.why: 0 wins in 18 trades across the fixed and @ai copies (-515 and -457) as price keeps crossing back over VWAP. The inverted copy won 10/10 but netted only Rs 6 after charges, so inverting adds no edge; s

opening_drive_fade.why: The opening window is long gone and the @ai copy is down Rs 149 on 2 trades. The inverted copy's Rs 22 is no edge, so stop it adding late, low-quality fades.

ema_cross.why: Crossovers whipsaw in a flat chop like this one. A slower slow EMA and a wider stop mean fewer, stronger signals and less lost to charges.

squeeze_break.why: Keep the nearer target. With volume at about half of normal, midday breakouts are unlikely to run 3 ATR.
